name: Helen Wells
introduction: I’m Helen Wells, an SEO copywriter and marketing specialist. I create search-informed website copy, destination guides, and engaging articles that help readers find what they need and brands tell their stories.
aboutHeading: A writer with a strategy behind every word.
aboutBody: My work brings together research, search intent, and clear, engaging storytelling. I've developed SEO-focused website content, destination guides, blog articles, and digital marketing copy for travel, vacation rental, and renter-focused brands. Whether a reader is planning a coastal getaway or looking for practical rental advice, my goal is the same: make the content genuinely useful.
aboutNote: I enjoy finding the balance between what people are searching for and what makes a story worth reading.
experienceHeading: Content that meets readers where they are.
experienceBody: At Bluetent / Inhabit, I contributed SEO-focused content, blogs, destination guides, and digital marketing copy for vacation rental brands. My published writing also spans renter education, property management, and lifestyle topics.
experienceFocus: SEO content • destination guides • digital marketing
